Administering KoldFusion Server

Java

New in KoldFusion 4.5. The Java page records the Java Virtual Machine settings that Java CFX tags and CFOBJECT TYPE="Java" would use.

Go there: Open the Java page (or inside the frameset)

Field Default Purpose
Java Virtual Machine Path /usr/java/jdk1.2.2/jre/lib/i386/classic/libjvm.so The JVM library to load
Class Path (blank) Extra directories and JAR files to search for classes
Initial Heap Size 1024 KB Starting heap
Max Heap Size 16384 KB Largest heap
System Options (blank) JVM system options, as OPT1=value;OPT2=value
Implementation Options (blank) Vendor-specific JVM options, in the same form
CFX Jar Path kfroot/java/classes/cfx.jar The cfx.jar that Java CFX tags compile against

Click Apply to save. The page reminds you to restart the server afterwards.

What actually happens

KoldFusion never loads a Java Virtual Machine, so every field here is cosmetic. The status line at the bottom of the page says so. A Java CFX tag fails with "Error loading Java CFX", and CFOBJECT always raises an error. C/C++ CFX tags, registered on the CFX Tags page, work fine and need no JVM at all.

Note  In 1999 the 16 MB default heap was generous. Your workstation had 64 MB of RAM, and Netscape wanted most of it.
